findings.body: The user is shown Italian text ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:") instead of Lithuanian, breaking localization for the lt locale.
findings.evidence: totpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:
findings.failure_mode: Wrong-language string rendered to end users.
findings.impact: The user is shown Italian text ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:") instead of Lithuanian, breaking localization for the lt locale.
findings.root_cause: Copy-paste of the Italian translation into the Lithuanian properties file during the message rewrite.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the Italian string with the correct Lithuanian translation, e.g. "Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame įrenginyje:".
findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.trigger: A Lithuanian-locale user opens the TOTP setup page in the account console.
findings.verifier_reason: Patch line R101 in messages_lt.properties shows totpStep1 changed from Lithuanian to Italian text 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:'. This is a clear localization bug introduced by the patch.

findings.body: The Lithuanian message key loginTotpStep1 now shows Italian text ('Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:') instead of Lithuanian, so Lithuanian users see an untranslated/foreign-language instruction.
findings.evidence: loginTotpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:
findings.failure_mode: User-facing localized message renders in the wrong language for the lt locale.
findings.impact: The Lithuanian message key loginTotpStep1 now shows Italian text ('Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:') instead of Lithuanian, so Lithuanian users see an untranslated/foreign-language instruction.
findings.root_cause: During the rewording that strips embedded anchor HTML from loginTotpStep1, the Italian source string was copy-pasted into the Lithuanian properties file instead of a Lithuanian translation.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the Italian string with the correct Lithuanian translation matching the other locales' rewording, e.g. 'Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame telefone:'.
findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.trigger: A user with the Lithuanian (lt) locale reaches the OTP setup screen and reads the first configuration step.
findings.verifier_reason: Patch line R71 in login/messages_lt.properties shows loginTotpStep1 changed from Lithuanian to Italian 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:'. This is a distinct file (login vs account) from candidate 0, so it's an independently fixable site.
